report:
The suspect vehicle had lost a front wheel.
The vehicle got stuck at a construction site.
Deputies detained the driver.
The driver appeared to be under the influence.
The driver resisted and kicked a deputy while being escorted into the back of a patrol vehicle.
When asked about the crash, the driver responded "What crash?"
The driver asked deputies to release him in exchange for $2,000.
The driver walked to the patrol car calmly and without resisting.
The driver said he was late for a job interview.

source.title: I-4 reckless drunk driver
